outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: Has the mug identified in the source image been moved to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
nodes.criteria: Pass if comparison of the source and edited images establishes that the source mug has been relocated to the right of the headphones. A separate right-side mug alone is insufficient. Fail if the source mug can be identified and remains left of the headphones or otherwise has not reached the requested position, or if clear visual evidence establishes that a different mug was added instead of moving the source mug. Return unknown if blur, occlusion, or ambiguous correspondence prevents determining the source mug's identity or final position. Execution or transport failures are not visual evidence of failure.
nodes.binding: Track the source image's blue mug, initially left of the black headphones with its handle facing left, into the edited image using its visible appearance and scene correspondence. Compare that mug's final position with the headphones in the edited image. Inspect the blurred blue region on the left and both white mug-like objects without automatically substituting the rightmost mug for the source mug.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

observations.evidence: The source mug is a blue mug with its handle facing left. In the edited image, a blurred blue region remains on the left, while two white mug-like objects are visible near the headphones and on the right. The blur and changed appearance prevent confidently establishing whether the source blue mug was moved or whether either white mug corresponds to it, so its final position relative to the headphones cannot be determined.
